title: Coarse Black Pepper

title: Coarse Cornmeal

title: Coarse Semolina
description: Coarse Semolina is a coarsely milled wheat used to make cereals, puddings, pasta, and sweet dishes. Semolina is quite popular in South Asian and African cuisine.

title: Coriander Powder (Dhania)

title: Crushed Chilli
description: Dial up the heat with a sprinkling of our extra hot crushed chillies. Stir into your favourite dishes or add sparingly as a table condiment to pack a punch. Our crushed chillies can invigorate everyday meals like pasta and soup for fiery flavours.

title: Cumin Powder
description: Our warm and aromatic cumin powder is at the heart of South Asian cooking and many more cuisines. Sprinkle on stir fries, salads, or in aloo gobi and stews for a distinctive musky taste. A perfect partner to meat and vegetables.

title: Cumin Seeds
description: Our warm and aromatic cumin powder is at the heart of Indian cooking and other cuisines. Sprinkle on stir fries, salads, or in aloo gobi and stews for a distinctive musky taste. A perfect partner to meat, vegetables and more, cumin is sure to add delight to your dishes.

title: Fennel Seeds
description: Sweet and aromatic with liquorice tones, our fennel seeds are perfect for flavouring everything from curries to cakes. This mild and fragrant seed is an ideal partner for fish dishes and adds flavour to soups and salads. Dry roast to enhance the aroma.

title: Fenugreek Leaves
description: Our intense and bittersweet fenugreek leaves are an ideal spice in curries. Aromatic with a maple syrup flavour, our fenugreek leaves are a flavoursome addition to many savoury dishes. Keep it in your pantry to add flavour to everything from sauces to stews.

title: Fenugreek Seeds
description: Our intense and bittersweet fenugreek seeds are ideal in curries. Aromatic with a maple syrup flavour, our fenugreek seeds are a flavoursome addition to many savoury dishes. Keep it in your pantry to add flavour to everything from sauces to stews.

title: Fine Desiccated Coconut
description: Desiccated coconut is finely ground coconut, rather than bigger strips. It is high in fibre. This is also usually drier than shredded coconut.

title: Fine Semolina
description: Enjoy the lovely aroma of baking with our fine semolina. Make sweet dishes like a traditional semolina pudding or savoury favourites like pasta and pizza. This versatile ingredient is a perfect pantry staple.

title: Garam Masala
